Rules / Formatting

SK0203 The object creation is not arranged

skala arrange would add or remove the type in an object creation expression.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSemantic
Needs a compilationyes
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floorC# 9.0
Since2.0

Why

Target-typed new removes a repeated type only where the surrounding context supplies exactly that type. Binding is required so a cleanup never changes overload resolution or the constructed type.

Example

Instead of:

List<int> values = new List<int>();

Write:

List<int> values = new();

When it does not fire

None relative to the effective configuration and language version. Unresolved or differently typed constructions are left alone.

Configuration

  • resharper_csharp_object_creation_when_type_evident
  • resharper_csharp_object_creation_when_type_not_evident
